name: Lithium-ion battery energy storage
principle: Lithium-ion cells (mainly LFP for stationary use since 2022) store grid power for short durations. NREL's 2024 baseline uses an 85% round-trip efficiency, 15 year life with augmentation, and projects capex cuts for a 60 MW, 4-hour system of 18, 37 or 52% by 2035.

process_steps.name: Charge from grid or renewables via PCS
Store in cell racks with thermal management
